description: A chain of generator stages where each stage pulls from the previous one only when the next one asks.
The consumer's `next()` drives every stage, so no buffer grows between them and memory stays bounded by one item or chunk.
The place where a lazy result becomes a list; ideally only at the sink, for small results that are needed again.
The stage that owns a resource's lifetime and releases it in `try`/`finally`, so exhaustion, errors and `close()` all clean up.
In a lazy chain an exception is raised when the bad item is reached, so the message must name the input that caused it.
